notes: The 20-day vs 60-day return comparison needs maths over two fields, and it sits on one side of an 'or', so the whole 'or' is one boolean formula.

formulas.name: draft_ret20_beats_ret60_or_rsi_oversold
formulas.description: True when the 20-day return is higher than the 60-day return, or the 14-day RSI is under 30
formulas.null_meaning: A return or the RSI is missing, so the test cannot be evaluated and the name does not pass

parts.words: the 20 day return beats the 60 day return or RSI14 under 30
parts.reading: 20-day return above 60-day return, or RSI 14 under 30, as one formula
